subject: general
question: In a certain code language, '95784' is written as 'EGYPT', and '23614' is written as 'LIKRT'. How will ' 462893 ' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

'95784' is written as 'EGYPT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88ba08a4da2477d229a024eca1a6e77e88ae55ad2c1445dbd6a25815c6821907.png] 

And,

'23614' is written as 'LIKRT'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fc95404590daf7666c94e6060efc5c64d9f901ab9ecfaa3dfa09f060e86ff39.png] 

So, ' 462893 ' be written as TKLPEI form the given coded numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e6428468e6d814953d1232f7ccd110b7ec5a71e29690fe3e08474f63fa5c9a1.png] 

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
